edges.label: evidence
edges.says: 16 flights to and from Madeira airport cancelled, mostly this morning (7 arrivals, 9 departures: Lisbon, Porto, Paris, Nantes)

edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Occurrence count, mainland: 66 at 03:30, none classed significant; 4 floods (Mem Martins, Cacém e São Marcos, Península de Setúbal); 60 responders, 22 vehicles

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Porto Santo: power cuts and some communication difficulties reported

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: 18 sea bars closed at 07:30 because of the weather; considerable worsening of sea conditions on the mainland until 12:00 Thursday (waves up to about 6 m significant height)

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Occurrence count, mainland: 60 to 06:00, mostly floods; Greater Lisbon and the Setúbal Peninsula most affected

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: 222 flights cancelled at Lisbon and Faro by 09:20 (departures and arrivals): 208 at Lisbon (Humberto Delgado), 14 at Faro

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Vasco da Gama bridge limited to 100 km/h since 07:30 for reduced visibility; usual limits on the 25 de Abril bridge; Lusoponte advises against motorcycles and high-sided vehicles

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Occurrence count, Lisbon city: about 50 from 00:00 to 10:00, mostly floods

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Government meets at São Bento; reiterates that prevention is the key word and that the storm has not yet entered the mainland

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Speed reduced on both bridges: 60 km/h on the 25 de Abril, 80 km/h on the Vasco da Gama

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Occurrence count, Lisbon: 144 from 00:00 to 12:00 (128 floods); 59 active, 85 closed

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Occurrence count, mainland: 530 from 00:00 to 12:00 (falling trees and other usual situations); special readiness kept at the highest level; intense rain expected from 13:00, most between 15:00 and 18:00; the national commander: the phenomenon is shifting…
